{"type":"thought","data":"I have reviewed the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market data and am ready"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to place my bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNemiga holds a clear"}
{"type":"thought","data":" advantage. Their HLTV"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and VRS rankings are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" higher than DENDELE's."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Nemiga also beat Legacy,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" who had previously "}
{"type":"thought","data":"beaten DENDELE. Nemiga"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dominates the core "}
{"type":"thought","data":"map pool with Cache "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 69% versus DENDELE's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 58%. The match is scheduled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for 10 hours from now."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNemiga bans Inferno,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" DENDELE's best map."}
{"type":"thought","data":" DENDELE bans Dust2,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Nemiga's solid map."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The remaining maps "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favor Nemiga heavily."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The odds are 0.585 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for Nemiga versus 0.415"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for DENDELE. The fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 58-62%. The HLTV community"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate is 65.5%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nPolymarket shows 59%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Nemiga and 41% DENDELE."}
{"type":"thought","data":" My estimate is 62-68%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Nemiga. Nemiga "}
{"type":"thought","data":"lost two matches to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stronger opponents recently."}
{"type":"thought","data":" DENDELE has momentum"}
{"type":"thought","data":" after beating G2 and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won pistols."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe earlier player"}
{"type":"thought","data":" comparison was between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" KaiR0N and doc, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team ratings. DENDELE's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win over G2 is misleading"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because G2 was already"}
{"type":"thought","data":" collapsing. Nemiga "}
{"type":"thought","data":"still beat Legacy 2-0"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while DENDELE lost "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to them. The map veto"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is the strongest edge:"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Nemiga can ban Inferno"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and play into maps "}
{"type":"thought","data":"where they have a 65-71%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate versus DENDELE's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 44-58%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm Nemiga is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" clear choice. At a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"64% probability, the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet yields roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"+9.4 tokens profit. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The underdog option "}
{"type":"thought","data":"would only be profitable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if DENDELE were priced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above 41.5%, which "}
{"type":"thought","data":"seems unlikely."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will bet on Nemiga"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with confidence 0.64."}
{"type":"thought","data":" My prior esports favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have performed well,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so this pick aligns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with my track record."}
